description: This file provides a function to fetch and normalize a list of organization tenants from an API endpoint. It exports the 'listOrganizations' function and a default object containing it. The code handles various data structures and key variants in the API response to produce a consistent array of organizations with id and name properties.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches a list of organizations (tenants) for the current user by calling the API '/session/tenants', normalizes key variants, sorts the list by name and ID, and returns an array of organizations with id and name fields.
